fixes.rationale_full: The legacy path ignored exchange-reported aborts from the moment upgrades.run started (upgrading flag), though no 101 exists until the session's onOpen. The gate now sits at onOpen and is decided under the DefaultResponse monitor: DefaultResponse.openSession() (synchronized) returns false unless state==NEW, else sets sessionOpen; the exchange hook is res::abortByExchange, which shares abort's synchronized block and returns when sessionOpen is set, so open-vs-abort is atomic (FND-202 check-then-act removed). WebSocketUpgrade.run hands res to the session (session.response(res)); DefaultWebSocketSession.onOpen asks openSession() first and on false marks itself refused, aborts the channel and returns without the 101 line, opening() or the handler; onClose of a refused session writes no WS close line. Pre-open abort then leaves the response ABORTED (listeners once via abort, one 'GET /ws ... aborted' line from onDone); a webSocket throw before opened() still propagates to errors.handle, which leaves an ABORTED response unchanged; res.upgraded() is a no-op on ABORTED. After a successful openSession the exchange abort is a no-op, keeping FR-APP-019 AC-8.
